research_status: Independent FCFF reconstruction; research-grade conditional on BCC/post-August capital
decision_es: Esperar precio o evidencia. Base 238,53 con capital agosto; BCC/uso revolver pendientes. Sin entrada.
decision_en: Wait for price or evidence. Base238.53 with August capital; BCC/revolver uses unresolved. No entry.
pros_es: Retención de ASV superior a 95% y crecimiento orgánico de ingresos de 6,7% sostienen la calidad de suscripción.
FCF menos SBC crece 12,07% y la debilidad material anterior de controles está remediada según el 10-K.
FDS cotiza a múltiplos GAAP y de caja menores que MSCI, con software incluido en ambos capex.
cons_es: Añadiendo solo reestructuración, EBIT queda prácticamente plano; la recuperación de margen aún es una hipótesis de guía.
La caja incluye 62,553 M$ de aportación de remuneración acumulada; no se perpetúa esa financiación.
El central de 238,53 no respalda 332,59; BCC y el uso del revolver posterior impiden certificar capital combinado actual.
pros_en: ASV retention above 95% and organic revenue growth of 6.7% support subscription quality.
FCF less SBC grew 12.07%, and the prior material control weakness is remediated according to the 10-K.
FDS trades at lower GAAP earnings and cash multiples than MSCI, including software in both capex figures.
cons_en: Adding back only restructuring leaves EBIT roughly flat; margin recovery remains a guidance-based assumption.
Cash flow includes a $62.553m benefit from accrued compensation; that funding is not perpetuated.
The $238.53 central case does not support $332.59; BCC and subsequent revolver uses prevent current combined-capital certification.
publication_note: Preserve A022198/248/295 as historical exploratory numbers. Original A022 code unavailable; never label exact reproduction. Central uses August capital and annual model convention; combined BCC not certified. No15% universal rule, no Stage3.5 approval.
